title: Reconstructing a set from its tail
statement: Let $T\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$ be finite and contain $0$. The set obtained by taking the positive-index elements of $T$, shifting their indices down by one, and adjoining $0$ is exactly $T$.
